title: Skin Care for Chennai Weather: A Light Routine for Heat, Humidity and Rain
ex: Hot, humid days, strong sun, the October to December monsoon and AC offices: how to keep a light, simple skin care routine for Chennai weather.
rt: Skin Care for Chennai Weather: Humid-Climate Guide | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Chennai weather: light moisturiser, daily sunscreen, sweat and oily skin, the Oct–Dec monsoon, AC offices and hard water, with a simple routine.
quick: Chennai is hot and humid most of the year, so skin needs a light moisturiser instead of heavy creams, a broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning even on rainy days, and a proper cleanse at night to remove sweat. Use a thin layer of night cream and keep the T-zone light.
facts: Chennai's main rains come with the northeast monsoon, roughly October to December
The city rarely has a real winter
Cloudy days still let much of the UV through
Oily skin can still be dehydrated
